title: Central scheduler queue loses waiting entries: a requested slot with no recent activity drops out of Opus2's queue across long waits and context compactions (w-eb8d lost twice)
outcome: Every Central cargo, pair and evaluator slot request that the scheduler accepted stays in a durable pending-queue record until it is launched, withdrawn by its owner, or explicitly cancelled with a reason sent to the owner, so that no accepted entry disappears silently across long waits, scheduler context compaction or a scheduler restart.
acceptance: Central scheduler queue loses waiting entries: a requested slot with no recent activity drops out of Opus2's queue across long waits and context compactions (w-eb8d lost twice) is done
